title: ReviewOutput
description: The closed JSON object the review model returns for one run: the findings and the summary that becomes the review body. Mirrors the Pydantic model ReviewOutput in app/modules/reviews/application/review_output.py: every key is required, nullable keys carry null instead of being omitted, and no other keys are allowed.
$comment: This schema is the single source of the output SHAPE. Rules JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the Pydantic model (runtime) and by review/scripts/validate_findings.py (proof-runs and fixtures): findings ordered by severity (critical, high, medium, low, info), then by confidence descending; the per-finding and summary rules noted in their own $comment. JSON Schema `integer` also admits 1.0, which the strict Pydantic model and the script reject for line and start_line.

findings.description: At most 10 findings, ordered by severity, then by confidence descending. May be empty.

ReviewFinding.description: One finding anchored to new-version lines of a file in the diff.
ReviewFinding.$comment: No `side` key: the model always anchors on the new version (RIGHT); the post-processor sets `side` (api#20 D6). Enforced outside this schema by the Pydantic model and validate_findings.py: start_line < line when start_line is not null; title is a single line (str.splitlines) and does not end with a period. Enforced by validate_findings.py only: a non-null rule_name requires the body to start with "According to custom instructions in '<rule_name>' (", and a null rule_name forbids that prefix; at runtime the post-processor repairs this binding instead (review/postprocess/lint-filter.md, step 6).

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, as it appears in the diff.

line.description: The anchor line in the new version of the file; the last line of a multi-line range.

start_line.description: The first line of a multi-line range, strictly before `line`; null for a single-line anchor.

body.description: The explanation in Markdown. 1200 characters is the hard ceiling; the prompt's 120-word target is not part of this contract.

suggestion.description: A drop-in replacement for lines start_line..line (or line), no prose and no diff markers; null when there is none.

confidence.description: The model's confidence in the finding.

rule_name.description: The name of the custom rule the finding enforces, quoted verbatim in the body's attribution prefix; null for a standard finding.

ReviewSummary.description: The summary rendered into the review body.
ReviewSummary.$comment: Enforced outside this schema by the Pydantic model and validate_findings.py: problem is exactly one sentence and done_well is one or two sentences (a sentence is a run of text ending in '.', '!' or '?' followed by whitespace or the end).

problem.description: One sentence naming the main issue.

done_well.description: One or two sentences on what is done well.
